title: Morphics Spectrum Drop (rare drop from wild enemies only)

source.description: Spectrums drop only from regular enemies found in the wild, never from bosses.

match.description: The entry matches the enemy's top-level body type. Every subcategory under it (such as small beast under beast) inherits the same Spectrum.

enemy_base.description: Top-level body type (the root). Wild enemies of this type and of every subcategory below it drop this Spectrum.

spectrum.description: Must be the spectrum of enemy_base. Enemies never drop another category's spectrum.

chance.description: Drop chance per defeated enemy. Rare: at most 10 percent. PLACEHOLDER, set by playtest.
